method.blocks: docs/requirements.yaml is split into blocks by text (a block starts at `  - id: REQ-NNN`; criteria are the items under `acceptance_criteria:`); the same split of `git show b64562a:docs/requirements.yaml` gives the text at AUD-001.

method.way_of_checking: Keyword rules over the text of each criterion: a test or the check command (`npm run check`, `node --test`, a path under tools/test or app/test, the words «тест», «test», «мутант»), a browser or UAT, a real run, a reader, another tools command; the rest is «by reading».
method.limits: The rules read words, not meaning: a criterion that names a test only as a reference is still counted as a test criterion (the count of test criteria is an upper bound; «by reading only» is a lower bound). RELEASE-VALIDATOR reads the criterion itself. The criteria of REQ-002 … REQ-006 were read in full by the scout.
